newsitem.title: USA: Imex says enters intent for Thermo Electron.
newsitem.headline: Imex says enters intent for Thermo Electron.

text.p: Imex Medical Systems Inc said Friday it had entered into a letter of intent to merge into Thermo Electron Corp's Nicolet Biomedical Inc subsidiary.
Imex said cash consideration for the deal will be $10,000,000 less the amount by which Imex's stockholders' equity at June 30 is less than $4,000,000.
Imex said it expects that the the price per share if the merger is completed would be $1.38 to $1.44.

The acquisition is contingent upon, among other things, the satisfactory completion of Thermo Electron due diligence, the negotiation and execution of a definitive acquisition agreement which must be approved by the boards of directors of both companies and by Imex stockholders and regulatory approvals.
